ui.ship_p.back: After the order is made true (confirmed), it is packed and sent within 2 working days, and after sending it usually arrives in 2 to 7 days. Wherever in India we give delivery, there delivery is free on 2 or more packs and ₹81 for one pack. Give money with UPI, or for orders up to ₹999 in South India and up to ₹599 in other places, give money at the time of delivery.
